items.why: Leading a chip selloff after a Gartner warning on AI infrastructure spending risk and TSMC falling despite record profit. Yahoo Finance says Nvidia is leading chip stocks lower.
Swept up in the same semiconductor rout, with the chip ETFs down over 2% as AI trade doubts spread across Nvidia, Broadcom and Qualcomm.
Small caps caught a bid as money rotated out of AI winners into the rest of the market, alongside the Dow's 600-point jump on the broaden-out trade.
Slipped ahead of tonight's Roadster unveiling after nine years of delays, with hot CPI data and rising Treasury yields weighing on high-beta tech.

market_note: After the close: Dow futures up 1.1%, S&P futures up 0.3%, Nasdaq futures down 0.2%; oil up 2.5% and gold up 2.1%.
summary: Rotation day: the Dow jumped about 600 points and small caps rallied while chip stocks sold off hard on AI capex doubts. That left the S&P 500 near flat and the Nasdaq lower at the close.
